correctness.rationale: A fully finite proof reconstructs 2^n binary strings and quotients by rotations. At lengths 1..8, explicit nonoverlapping necklace codebooks and rational dual output covers have matching values. At length 9 an exact fractional primal and dual each have total 41/4; nine input necklaces have disjoint shadows; 19 explicitly verified pairwise-conflicting cliques with rational weights covering all 60 inputs have cost 59/6<10, forcing the integral maximum to equal 9. The standalone exact-arithmetic verifier checks each inequality directly from certificates.json; it returned VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: This is a natural finite synchronization-channel benchmark in which strings have no distinguished origin, and the received object is also a circle. Identifying the first length at which the basic fractional deletion-shadow bound fails is mathematically motivated by the integrality of coding capacities. The explicit clique bound supplies a structural, strictly stronger finite obstruction; the exact 41/4 versus 9 gap is not merely an arbitrary isolated computation. No unnecessary infinite downstream theorem is claimed.
